scripts.build: npm run build:shared && npm run build -w apps/functions && npm run build -w apps/daemon && npm run build -w apps/web
scripts.typecheck: npm run build:shared && npm run typecheck -w packages/shared && npm run typecheck -w apps/functions && npm run typecheck -w apps/daemon && npm run typecheck -w apps/web && tsc -p tsconfig.scripts.json
scripts.test:emulator: npm run setup:local && firebase emulators:exec --project demo-chefjuno --only auth,firestore,functions,hosting "vitest run --project emulator && playwright test"
scripts.test: npm run test:unit && npm run test:web && npm run test:emulator
scripts.verify: node scripts/guard-tests.mjs && npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm run build && npm run test
scripts.demo: npm run setup:local && npm run build && firebase emulators:exec --project demo-chefjuno --only auth,firestore,functions "tsx scripts/demo.ts"
scripts.dev: npm run setup:local && npm run build:shared && npm run build -w apps/functions && node scripts/dev.mjs
scripts.screenshots: npm run setup:local && npm run build:shared && npm run build -w apps/functions && npm run build -w apps/web && firebase emulators:exec --project demo-chefjuno --only auth,firestore,functions,hosting "playwright test --config playwright.screenshots.config.ts"
scripts.dev:fresh: npm run setup:local && npm run build:shared && npm run build -w apps/functions && node scripts/dev.mjs --fresh
